assertions.assertion: The appeal is for the CO-197 denial
The denied service is CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry)
The denial cited absence of required precertification
The appeal is for episode ep-05024
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42)
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes contributing to symptomatic episodes
The appeal requests payment of the outstanding balance of 581.63
The service was rendered 58 days ago
The appeal is submitted within the 122 days remaining to the filing deadline
